title: Barre Studio — Restored Living Room
summary: Original floors, exposed shiplap and a repaired plank ceiling restored in the former living room, now home to the barre studio.
serviceLinkLabel: See the repaired plank ceiling in the barre studio
searchSummary: Barre studio in the restored living room: original floors, exposed shiplap and reclaimed ceiling repairs, completed in August/September 2026 before the November reopening.
recorded: March–November 2026; restoration completed in August/September, followed by decorating and studio preparation.
sourceLabel: Former living room restoration journal and Home Reno - Studio Google Photos album

gallery.caption: The barre and mirrors in the restored studio, November 11, 2026.
gallery.alt: A wooden barre runs across a group of framed mirrors beside exposed shiplap, pottery shelves and the refinished wood floor.

gallery.caption: The former living room at the start of the recorded work, March 16, 2026.
gallery.alt: Blue walls and white trim surround a worn brown wood floor, with a shop vacuum in the room.

gallery.caption: Hand tools and lifted finish at the edge of the original floor, March 16, 2026.
gallery.alt: Scrapers and curled finish shavings lie on wood flooring beside a floor register and white baseboard.

gallery.caption: The restored room furnished for its new studio use, November 7, 2026.
gallery.alt: Refinished wood flooring leads toward an exposed shiplap wall, an open black door, mirrors and furnishings beneath a white plank ceiling.

gallery.caption: The retained shiplap, black door and refinished floor with the room decorated, November 11, 2026.
gallery.alt: An open black door in the shiplap wall reveals the staircase beyond, beside a colorful window treatment and refinished wood flooring.

gallery.caption: The bay windows, wood display shelves and refinished floor in the furnished studio, November 9, 2026.
gallery.alt: Three bay windows with white trim and floral coverings sit beneath wood display shelves and a white plank ceiling, with the refinished floor and studio equipment below.

introduction: The former living room in Shawn and Haley’s 1894 residence is now home to the barre studio and Repair Shop. Restoring its original floors, exposed shiplap and plank ceiling came first; furnishing and decorating followed.
evidenceBoundary: Shawn confirms restoration completion in August/September 2026 and the November 7 grand reopening/student appreciation event. The selected photographs show condition, floor preparation and the furnished room; they do not establish an exact move day or event attendance.
